skill.summary: Write Makefiles for any project type. Use when setting up build automation, defining multi-target builds, managing dependencies between tasks, creating project task runners, or using Make for non-C projects (Go, Python, Docker, Node.js). Also covers Just and Task as modern alternatives.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: Make basics, automatic variables, pattern rules, Go/Python/Node/Docker Makefiles, multi-directory builds, Just and Task alternatives
